noun_definition: Task description editing page field refers to the input area where users can enter or modify the description of a task, which is incorrectly marked as mandatory when it should be optional during the editing of an existing task.
Task refers to a specific item or assignment within the application that users can create, edit, and manage, which includes a title and description.
Field refers to the input area in the task description editing page that is incorrectly marked as mandatory when it should be optional, allowing users to save without entering a title.
